description: The file is the main source code for an Android application's Home activity, managing application launcher grid, favorites, recents, wallpaper, and menu options.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Main activity class managing app launcher, favorites, recents, wallpaper, and menu options for the Android home screen.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, registers receivers, loads applications, and binds UI components.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters receivers.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes recents when activity resumes.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores UI state, such as whether application grid was open.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves UI state, such as whether application grid was open.

methods.name: registerIntentReceivers
methods.description: Registers broadcast receivers for wallpaper changes and package changes.

methods.name: bindApplications
methods.description: Sets up the applications grid view with installed applications.

methods.name: bindFavorites
methods.description: Loads and binds favorite applications from an XML file.

methods.name: beginDocument
methods.description: Helper to parse XML documents.

methods.name: nextElement
methods.description: Advances XML parser to next element.

methods.name: bindRecents
methods.description: Loads and binds recent applications.

methods.name: getApplicationInfo
methods.description: Retrieves ApplicationInfo given an intent.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Handles focus changes.

methods.name: dispatchKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key events like back and home.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu with wallpaper, search, and settings.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu items.

methods.name: startWallpaper
methods.description: Starts activity to pick wallpaper.

methods.name: loadApplications
methods.description: Loads list of installed applications.

methods.name: showApplications
methods.description: Shows the application grid with optional animation.

methods.name: hideApplications
methods.description: Hides the application grid with animation.

methods.name: WallpaperIntentReceiver
methods.description: BroadcastReceiver handling wallpaper change events.

methods.name: ApplicationsIntentReceiver
methods.description: BroadcastReceiver handling application package add/remove/change events.

methods.name: ApplicationsAdapter
methods.description: Adapter to display application icons and labels in grid.

methods.name: ShowApplications
methods.description: Click listener to toggle application grid visibility.

methods.name: HideGrid
methods.description: AnimationListener for hiding application grid.

methods.name: ShowGrid
methods.description: AnimationListener for showing application grid.

methods.name: ApplicationLauncher
methods.description: Handles launching applications when grid item is clicked.

methods.name: ClippedDrawable
methods.description: Custom drawable to draw wallpaper without stretching.
